title: Parking Violation Notice from City of Maplewood
urgency_reason: The fine increases if not paid within 21 days, and unpaid fines may be sent to collections.
summary: This is a parking ticket from the City of Maplewood for an expired meter in Zone B. The total amount due is $85.00, which includes a base fine, administration fee, and enforcement surcharge. You must pay or contest the ticket within 21 days of the issue date, or the fine will increase to $170.00 and could be sent to collections.
eli5: You parked too long and the city sent you a ticket for $85, but if you don't pay it in 21 days, it will cost $170 and they might send it to a debt collector.

deadlines.consequence: Unpaid fines increase to $170.00 and may be sent to collections.

red_flags.why: The fine doubles if not paid within 21 days, which is a common tactic to pressure quick payment.

signals: Official letterhead and verifiable reference number
Specific violation details and clear payment instructions

checklist.detail: Pay online at maplewood.gov/pay using the reference number PM-8842107 before 2026-10-03 to avoid the increased fee.
If you believe the ticket is wrong, submit Form PC-22 online or in person at the Violations Bureau, Room 114, City Hall, weekdays 8:30am-4:30pm.
Save a copy of the notice and any proof of payment or contestation for your records.

raw_text:
CITY OF MAPLEWOOD
PARKING VIOLATION NOTICE
Notice No: PM-8842107 Issue Date: 09/12/2026
Plate: XYZ-4412 Location: 1200 block, Elm St
Violation: Expired meter — Zone B (Ordinance 12.44)
Description Amount
Base fine $45.00
Administration fee $15.00
Enforcement surcharge $25.00
TOTAL DUE $85.00
Payment or contest must be received within 21 days of the issue date (by 10/03/2026). Unpaid fines increase to $170.00 after the deadline and may be sent to collections.
To contest: submit Form PC-22 online or appear at the Violations Bureau, Room 114, City Hall, weekdays 8:30am-4:30pm.
AMOUNT DUE: $85.00
Pay online: maplewood.gov/pay • Ref: PM-8842107
